title: RAW UNREVIEWED: preparation extent reverses the effect of one medicinal food, rather than merely increasing its strength
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Pliny XXII.142–145 supplies a complete lentil entry in which greater versus lesser cooking has opposed bowel effects. Draft a whole medicinal preparation account with material identity, preparation extent and effect direction bound jointly; compare a one-direction potency scale and two-material catalogue rival. No Voynich plant, process, property or degree word assigned.

source.work: Pliny, Naturalis historia XXII, chapterLXX, sections142–145, complete lentil entry before elelisphacos146
source.layer: Institutional hosted Latin transcription, not newly collated medieval manuscript. Historical source claims are not present medical recommendations.
bounded_complete_plan: 142 identifies lentils and desirable cooking/water-absorption properties; contrasts bowel binding, stronger with rainwater cooking, against loosening when less cooked; keeps eye, stomach and topical claims.
143 branches decoction and topical applications with separate additives, sites and indications.
144 preserves counted grains, cooking in three waters, prior roasting/grinding, optional adjuncts and contraindications.
145 retains powder use, partly cooked material for burns with later processing and honey, throat preparation, and separately introduces aquatic lentil.
source.source_limit: The aquatic-lentil subentry is a distinct material and must not be silently included in the same-material contrast. Preparation medium differs in one strengthened branch; the bare less-cooked clause supplies the opposing effect. No calibrated boiling durations or numerical potency function is stated.

design.whole_hypothesis_template: Introduce medicinal material M; state preparation P and its bodily effect E; contrast lesser completion of P on the same M with opposed E; continue with separately attached uses/additives and explicit harmful applications. Later introduction of another material opens another entry rather than changing M silently. All native roots, modifiers, sites and clause boundaries remain unassigned until a complete candidate account is authored.

finite_rivals.ONE_DIRECTION_STRENGTH: Greater preparation only intensifies the same signed effect; reduced preparation weakens it but does not reverse it.
finite_rivals.PREPARATION_REVERSAL: The same material produces opposed effects under the two explicitly distinguished preparation extents.
finite_rivals.TWO_MATERIALS: Opposed effects belong to different materials, with preparation extent incidental.

design.different_consequence: PREPARATION_REVERSAL requires identity reuse across the two preparation clauses and an opposed outcome, not merely repeated adjectives or numerical escalation. ONE_DIRECTION_STRENGTH cannot retain both signed outcomes. TWO_MATERIALS must spend a written subject distinction and cannot simply reset an otherwise retained subject. A generic adequately scoped preparation account remains a rival; no unique Pliny identification follows.
design.why_relevant: A herbal/pharmaceutical compiler can carry food preparation, medicinal ingestion and topical treatment within one entry. Broad process/function vocabulary need not name a single plant or visible object. This is a plausible subject matter account, not a claimed match to a particular drawing. Astral vocabulary is not explained by this offer.
design.grammar_frequency_contract: Reuse directed word composition plus whole-form residuals as constraints on a jointly authored writer, not as preassigned morphemes. Recurrent process and scope words must fit all exact-form profiles and repetitions across sections; plant-specific words cannot receive broad common forms merely for local fluency. No profile is needed to retain this unbound RAW, but each nominated lexical value must be profiled before use.

predecessors.retained: Existing helioscopium food/mild/strong branch remains incomplete in its joint target attempt. This source introduces opposed effect direction under changed cooking extent, not another graded positive-strength example. No reopening of its target or values.

Meum multi-preparation/overdose account already owns general branching. Novel difference must be retained identity plus opposed effect from less-cooked versus more-cooked preparation, not simply multiple uses.
Role-transfer counterexample and type-forced endpoint remain; no same-role argument is relabelled to repair them.
Recipe completeness and local amount/grade stops unchanged. A whole hypothesis is permitted, but old material or quantity identities are not evidence.

design.smallest_next_step: If shortlisted, nominate one already-owned complete paragraph with two written preparation/property constructions and author both one-direction and reversal readings jointly, preserving every unknown. Check source-specific same-material and changed-effect obligations rather than looking for a lentil picture. Do not open reserves or build a generic degree decoder.
limitations: No complete native paragraph currently bound.
Whether a target contrast is effect direction, degree, quality or two subjects remains open.
No forced 1:1 Latin mapping, exact-source matching or confirmed term required to author a C0 account.
Do not infer process identity from a shared substring alone.
design.duplicate_review: Route/topics read; registry searches lentil boiled, sage menstruation, preparation potency and rivals;801 followup review read. Empty lupin search was not treated as proof of novelty; lupin potency idea abandoned because source minores is ambiguous.
